analysis.one_line_summary: A blonde creator demonstrates how to style curtain bangs using the Wavytalk thermal round brush for a voluminous blowout look, followed by a color lineup.
analysis.full_description: A young blonde creator wearing a blue sweatshirt demonstrates a step-by-step tutorial on styling bangs using the white Wavytalk heated round brush. She shows how to roll and angle sections of her fringe away from her face to achieve bouncy, salon-style curtain bangs. After completing the styling, she fluffs her voluminous blonde hair to display the final blowout result, holds the brush toward the camera, and cuts to a flatlay showcase of the product available in five different pastel colors.

on_screen_text.text: how to style your bangs for the perfect blowout look

scenes.visual: Blonde creator in an apartment bedroom/living space rolling the white thermal round brush out of her curtain bangs.
scenes.action: She unwinds the thermal brush from her side bangs and touches the bouncy curled fringe into place.

scenes.visual: Creator facing the camera, holding one finger up before styling the front bangs.
scenes.action: She sections her front bangs, wraps them backward onto the heated brush barrel, rotates the brush to lock in heat, and gently pulls it out.

scenes.visual: Creator styling the adjacent bang section with the round brush.
scenes.action: She rolls the next bang section around the thermal brush away from her face and slides it through to create a swooped blowout layer.
She runs both hands through her hair, shaking it out to reveal voluminous, bouncy blonde blowout waves.

scenes.visual: Creator holding the white Wavytalk heated round brush forward.
scenes.action: She holds the styling brush up to the camera with a satisfied smile.

scenes.visual: Overhead flatlay shot of five Wavytalk thermal brushes laid out diagonally on a white fabric surface.
scenes.action: Static product display showcasing the five pastel colorways with text overlay.

hook.first_frame: Blonde woman with the white Wavytalk brush in her bangs under the headline text 'how to style your bangs for the perfect blowout look'.
hook.visual_0_3s: She releases a bouncy, curled bang strand from the heated round brush.
hook.text_0_3s: how to style your bangs for the perfect blowout look
hook.pattern_interrupt: Instant visual payoff of a freshly unwound, perfect blowout curl in the first two seconds.

narrative_beats: Quick hook showing an unwound blowout curl
Step-by-step rolling technique for front curtain bangs
Styling secondary layer for face-framing bounce
Final hair shake demonstrating full volume
key_claims: Styles bangs into the perfect blowout look

talent.hair_after: Bouncy, voluminous layered blonde blowout with sweeping curtain bangs
